visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit hallway with a grey door and an electronic keypad. A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a blue t-shirt with yellow stripes, stands with her back to the camera. She holds a white Samsung smartphone against the door lock, which glows blue. Yellow captions with comic-style motion lines appear around the phone. (2) The visual shifts to a close-up screen recording of a Samsung smartphone. Hands with neatly manicured nails navigate through the Samsung Wallet app interface, clicking on a '+' icon and selecting 'Digital Key' then 'NFC Access Card'. Graphic overlays show a person opening a door. A digital keypad appears, and the user enters a four-digit code before typing the name '芝麻開門' on a Korean/Chinese hybrid keyboard. (3) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman in a different indoor setting featuring a red brick wall. She holds her phone and demonstrates the upward swiping motion on the screen to activate the wallet app. She points to the phone while looking directly at the camera with an expressive, friendly facial expression. (4) The final segment features a humorous skit titled 'Divination Time'. The woman stands before a large dark grey door, holding her phone out as if asking a question. The lighting is more dramatic. The video ends with a montage of her reacting to the door not opening, including a black and white shot of her looking disappointed.

(2) A sharp transition introduces a tutorial phase. The voiceover becomes more structured and instructional, describing steps. Frequent 'pop' and 'click' digital UI SFX are synchronized with visual app interactions. Percussive electronic drums maintain a steady energy. The narrator's pitch is stable yet engaging. (3) The instructional segment continues with the narrator explaining technical details about the update. A second female voice enters briefly with a breathy, excited reaction ('Wow, so nice!'). The BGM swells slightly during a demonstration of the smartphone's swipe-up gesture. (4) The final phase features a thematic shift to 'divination'. The narrator's tone becomes more playful. An electronic lock beep SFX is followed by a dull 'thud' sound. The music shifts to a comical, minor-tonality resolution as the narrator jokes about the door not opening. A synthesized laugh track concludes the track.
